title: The Fusion Tax: A Diagnostic Analysis of When Hybrid Retrieval Hurts
abstract: arXiv:2610.30612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid retrieval, which fuses a sparse lexical retriever with a dense neural one, is widely recommended in the software documentation surveyed in September 2026, usually with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), on the strength of aggregate gains. We ask what fusion costs on individual queries, treating "do not fuse" as a first-class outcome, in the setting in which hybrid retrieval is deployed: a standard Anserini BM25, five dense encoders spanning 22M-596M parameters and three model generations, a learned-sparse (SPLADE) alternative, and a cross-encoder second stage, on seven BEIR datasets and three fusion functions. Even the best method, dense-weighted score interpolation, ranks relevant documents below the better of its two components on 13-48% of queries and below the deployable dense-only retriever on 8-21% (14-48% and 11-25% at a weight selected under leave-one-corpus-out validation), while beating dense-only in aggregate on every corp

translated_title: 融合税：混合检索何时造成损害的诊断性分析
translated_abstract: 混合检索——即将稀疏词法检索器与稠密神经检索器相融合——在2026年9月调研的软件文档中被广泛推荐，通常采用倒数排序融合（RRF），其依据是总体性能上的提升。我们研究融合在单个查询上付出了什么代价，并将“不融合”作为一个一等公民级别的结果来对待。实验设置正是混合检索实际部署的典型场景：标准的Anserini BM25、五个跨越2200万至5.96亿参数且涵盖三代模型的稠密编码器、一个学习型稀疏（SPLADE）替代方案，以及交叉编码器第二阶段重排，在七个BEIR数据集和三种融合函数上进行评估。即使是最好的方法——稠密加权分数插值——在13-48%的查询上，其将相关文档的排名低于两个组件中较好的那个，在8-21%的查询上低于可直接部署的纯稠密检索器（在留一语料库验证下选择权重时，这两个比例分别为14-48%和11-25%），同时在每个语料库的总体指标上仍优于纯稠密检索。
tldr: 该研究通过诊断分析发现，混合检索（如RRF融合）虽然在总体指标上优于纯稠密检索，但在8-48%的个体查询上反而损害检索效果，因此“不融合”应被视为值得认真对待的一等选项。
en_tdlr: This diagnostic analysis reveals that hybrid retrieval (e.g., with RRF fusion), while beating dense-only retrieval in aggregate, actually hurts ranking on 8-48% of individual queries, making "do not fuse" a first-class outcome worth considering.
